args.message: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and the FIN-212 requirement for banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`).

## Change
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): passed.
